Data Limitations.Impact: Limited statistical power; may not capture full PCOS phenotypic diversity

Data Limitations.Description: Data from 10 hospitals in Kerala, India only
Data Limitations.Impact: May not generalize to Philippine population (genetic, dietary, environmental differences)

Data Limitations.Description: PCOS minority class in original data
Data Limitations.Impact: SMOTE synthetic oversampling may not reflect real PCOS variability
Data Limitations.Evidence: Synthetic samples created via interpolation, not real patients

Data Limitations.Description: No data on symptom duration, disease progression, or treatment history
Data Limitations.Impact: Cannot distinguish early-stage vs. established PCOS; no longitudinal tracking

Data Limitations.Description: Hormone levels vary by time of day, menstrual cycle phase
Data Limitations.Impact: Single measurements may not represent typical levels
Data Limitations.Evidence: No standardization for cycle day or time of blood draw

Model Limitations.Description: Logistic Regression assumes linear feature-target relationships
Model Limitations.Impact: May miss complex non-linear interactions (e.g., hormone ratio thresholds)
Model Limitations.Evidence: Ensemble models showed similar performance, suggesting linearity holds

Model Limitations.Description: Model identifies associations, not causal relationships
Model Limitations.Impact: Cannot determine if features cause PCOS or are symptoms/correlates

Model Limitations.Description: Some features are biologically correlated (e.g., BMI + weight)
Model Limitations.Evidence: Feature selection removed highly correlated pairs

Deployment Limitations.Description: Model is a screening aid, NOT a replacement for clinical diagnosis
Deployment Limitations.Impact: Requires physician confirmation; cannot be used for treatment decisions
Deployment Limitations.Evidence: Rotterdam criteria require clinical judgment + ultrasound expertise

Deployment Limitations.Description: Full feature set requires ultrasound access (follicle counts)
Deployment Limitations.Impact: May not be feasible in rural community health centers
Deployment Limitations.Evidence: Top SHAP features include follicle counts

Deployment Limitations.Description: Community health workers need training on feature collection + interpretation
Deployment Limitations.Impact: Deployment cost and time for capacity building
Deployment Limitations.Evidence: Features require clinical knowledge (e.g., hirsutism scoring)
